h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Anantapur

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Anantapur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Anantapur

c: Anantapur is one of the driest districts in India, with low rainfall, strong sun and hot winds for much of the year. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Anantapur to municipal parks, schools, colleges, residential layouts and government campuses. We make the Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 720 km away, and deliver them by road into Rayalaseema.

In a dry climate, sun and dust do more damage than rain. Ultraviolet light slowly fades plastic, and fine dust works its way into moving joints. Our seats and handles are roto-moulded plastic, which holds its colour longer than painted parts, and the frames are galvanised steel. Two habits will add years to an open gym here. Wipe the machines down every week or two, and report any stiff joint to our after-sales team early. Shade from trees or a simple structure helps both the equipment and the people using it.

richText.heading: Keeping machines working in dust and sun

c: Machines with fewer moving parts are easier to keep in good shape in dusty conditions. The
has none at all and is useful for dips and stretching. The

has a simple wheel that is quick to clean. Mix these with one or two moving machines such as a walker, and keep a broom and cloth with the caretaker for weekly cleaning. Bearings carry a 1-year warranty and galvanised pipes carry 3 years, against manufacturing defects.

items.q: How do outdoor gym machines last in Anantapur's dry heat?
items.a: Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle heat and sun well. Regular wiping and early attention to stiff joints keep them working. Shade also slows colour fading.
Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road and install through our team or a dealer in south India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

items.q: How do we report a problem after installation?
items.a: Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or email aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.
